n_fail: # failures of the test in finished runs
Tests that failed before fail again (EDA §D heavy tail).
days_since_last_fail: days since the start of the most recent known failure; 9999 if none
Failures cluster in time (EDA §D/§G: LastFail is the strongest paper baseline).
fails_last_7d: # failures that became known in the last 7 days
fails_last_30d: # failures that became known in the last 30 days
last_outcome: outcome in the most recently finished run containing the test
n_transitions: # pass↔fail flips in the finished history
n_runs_seen: Confidence of the other history features.
fail_rate: Smoothed failure propensity; robust for short histories.
is_new_test: never seen in a finished run
EDA §D: new tests are 4.9% of first-time failures.
h_last_fail_same_stage: the most recent known failure happened in this stage
Lets the all-stage scope tell environment-specific failures apart.
dur_last_asof: duration in the latest finished run (same stage, else any stage, else run median)
Cost: cheap tests first maximises failures found per minute.
dur_ema_asof: EMA (α 0.3) of durations, same fallback chain
A smoother expected cost; the p/d denominator.
dur_source: How much to trust the duration.
test_file_in_diff: the test's own file is in the change (exact mapping)
EDA fact 2: 8.3% of first-time failures have their own file edited.
same_top_module: the test's top module equals a changed file's top module
path_prefix_overlap: longest common package prefix with any changed file, / test path length
name_token_overlap: # tokens shared by test path and changed paths
bm25_test_vs_diff: BM25 of test tokens vs diff tokens (paths + patch text); IDF over the run's tests
IR_GitDiff is the paper's best change-aware baseline on FirstFail.
has_change_data: the change was found in the compare data
cof_max: max over changed files of cof(f,x)/(nchg(f)+1), directory backoff for unseen files
Learned file→test dependencies beyond names (co-failure memory).
cof_sum: sum of the same scores over changed files
Several weakly linked files add up.
cof_count_max: max raw co-failure count over changed files

asof.history: computed only from runs whose end ≤ this run's start (streaming state applied in end order)
asof.cost: durations of finished runs only; this run's own durations are evaluation-only (`y_duration_s`)
asof.change: uses only the change (diff vs trunk) and the names of the tests in this run, known at start
asof.cofail: counts only finished runs (end ≤ start) where a file changed and the test failed

rejected: median 1 author and 2 commits per build (EDA §E): almost no variance
future knowledge (fix dates lie after the runs); used only to filter evaluation
leakage: known only after the test ran; kept as `y_duration_s` for evaluation
the exported model must score unseen repositories; a project id would memorise per-project base rates. Pooled models therefore get no project id (per-project behaviour is analysed instead)
